translations: English in title, place and summary; translations.de, .fr and .it override any of them, and a missing one falls back to English
facts: Language-neutral, never translated: buildingType (kebab-case id for filtering, not shown), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), survey (BIM or Splat), authoringTool (product name), codingAgent (model name as the building's records give it; null where they do not), builtPeriod ([first year, last year]; last year null where the sources give only an origin), federalSince (year the Confederation became the owner) and federalAcquisition (built, purchase, bequest or donation), both null where no source confirms them, sources (pages that confirm the history and ownership in the summary). Cards show country, survey, authoringTool and codingAgent as chips in that order, then tags
tags: Feature tags in one English form, never translated: 3D viewer, IFC download, Tour archive, Experiment, Research phase
